title: Chemistry Ventures is raising $500M for its second fund
slides: Chemistry Ventures targets $500M for its second fund.
First fund backed 30 startups in deep tech.
But only 2 reached a $100M valuation so far.
New fund will focus on climate and biotech deals.
Watch if LPs accept weaker first-fund returns now.
thread_text:
1. Second fund, weaker proof?

Chemistry Ventures targets $500M for its new fund after only 2 of 30 deep tech startups hit $100M.

2. Deep tech bets

First fund backed 30 startups. Most are still building — climate and biotech are the next focus.

3. The valuation gap

Only two exits reached nine figures. LPs now eye whether the model can scale returns sooner.

4. Pivot to climate and bio

New fund leans into climate and biotech deals. These sectors promise faster cycles or deeper moats.

5. You're the LP

Would you commit to a second fund after seeing that hit rate? Run your own due diligence on their portfolio today.

The next fund depends on institutional investors accepting weaker proof from the first one.💡
